items.label: LOADALL
items.why: the Adventure loader. The listing differs from the file in 70 of its 689 bytes: three at $C011 that the menu (LL, $9985) changes to JMP $C06E before it starts the loader, 18 operands that the loader's three copy loops count up as they run, and the 49 from $C280 that BNK4A loads over

items.label: TSETUP
items.why: 98 bytes of code that show the picture held at $6000. Only LOADALL asks for it ($C049), after a file TITLE that this disk does not have, and the menu changes $C011 of LOADALL to JMP $C06E, past both loads and the call, before it runs the loader. L, LL, LOADALL and LOADIT are the only files with a call to the KERNAL's LOAD, and no other names it

items.label: COLOR
items.why: the Adventure's colour RAM: LOADALL loads it at $6000 and copies its 1,024 bytes to $D800 ($C1E1). A listing of RAM does not hold colour RAM

items.label: BNK4A
items.why: every one of the 2,456 bytes the listing holds is equal; the other 1,000, at $CC00-$CFE7, are a play screen that the listing leaves out

items.label: DUMMY
items.why: 256 bytes that are a copy of TNK12A's bytes at $1000-$10FF. L, LL, LOADALL and LOADIT are the only files with a call to the KERNAL's LOAD, and none names it

items.label: TOLOR
items.why: the Training program's colour RAM: LOADIT loads it at $6000 ($C16B) and copies its 1,024 bytes to $D800 (the copy after $C182), as LOADALL does with COLOR; no page decodes it

items.label: TNK4A
items.why: every one of the 963 bytes the Training listing holds is equal; the other 2,493, at $C280-$C3FC, $C400-$C6FF, $C900-$CA3F and $CC00-$CFFF, are sprite buffers, status rows and colours the program writes as it runs, which the listing leaves out (parts/training/part.json)

items.label: TNK4B
items.why: LOADIT loads it at $1000 and copies $2FF0 bytes up to $D000-$FFEF, so the file's last nine bytes never reach memory. Every one of the 8,432 bytes the Training listing holds is equal; the other 3,840, at $E640-$F53F, are the picture band, which the program unpacks as it runs and the listing leaves out (parts/training/part.json)

items.label: LOADIT
items.why: the Training loader: when 1 is pressed the menu changes the name it loads from LOADALL to LOADIT (LL, $9817). It loads TNK4B, TNK4A, TNK3, TNK12A, TOLOR and TNK2B and starts the Training program. The Training listing holds none of it: the program builds sprites over $C000-$C27F as it runs (parts/training/part.json)

items.label: M
items.why: the Mindscape logo: a multicolour picture of 10,001 bytes (bitmap, screen colours, colour RAM, background), packed by run lengths. The menu (LL) loads it at $4000, unpacks it at $2000 ($9B0E) and shows it before the menu. On no page (TODO.md)

items.label: T
items.why: the title picture, FIST THE LEGEND CONTINUES, COPYRIGHT 1986 BEAM SOFTWARE, packed as M is. The menu unpacks it and shows it while the chosen program loads. The overview shows a screenshot of it; no page draws it from these bytes (TODO.md)

items.label: LL
items.why: the menu (1 Training, 2 Adventure), the unpacker for the two pictures M and T, and the copy protection's check

items.label: track 2, sector 0
items.why: the copy protection's sector: the menu's drive program reads it, and the menu then takes 256 bytes of its own code, $9866-$9965, from the drive's memory (orientation.md)
